name: Soft Coconut
summary:
Welcome to Soft Coconut, the ultimate VR multiplayer game where you swing, climb, and monkey around in immersive environments inspired by the classic tag genre. Built for fast-paced fun, goofy physics, and vibrant community interaction, Soft Coconut offers a dynamic experience that’s perfect for both casual players and competitive taggers alike.

Whether you're navigating chaotic obstacle-filled maps, chilling in cozy hangout zones, or showing off your wildest cosmetics, Soft Coconut is your digital jungle
